data.name: Sethian
data.gender_notes: Sethian is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Sethian is recorded in name-lists as “Appointed by God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sethian expresses “Appointed by God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sethian total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: שת
in_hebrew.meaning: מישהו שהוא מוחלף או נתן תחת מישהו אחר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם שמקורו בעברית, מילה שפירושה מישהו שהוא מוחלף או נתן תחת מישהו אחר, נזכר בתנך בספר בראשית כבנו השלישי של אדם

in_greek.name: Σήθ
in_greek.meaning: αυτός που αντικαθιστά ή δίδεται αντί καμιάς άλλης
in_greek.long_meaning: όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή, λέξη που σημαίνει αυτός που αντικαθιστά ή δίδεται αντί καμιάς άλλης, αναφέρεται στη Septuagint ως γιός του Αδάμ

in_latin.name: Seth
in_latin.meaning: ille qui substituitur vel datur pro alio
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen quod originem habet in Hebraeo, verbum quod significat ille qui substituitur vel datur pro alio, in Veteri Testamento memoratur in libro Genesis ut tertius filius Adae
